name: The Marlborough
positioning: Small luxury hotel in a preserved 1901 Victorian convent on a 16-acre garden and working vineyard estate in Rapaura, Marlborough
best_for: Wine lovers who want to stay on a working vineyard in Marlborough
Travelers who enjoy gardens, heritage buildings and a quiet rural setting

facts.text: The Marlborough is a small luxury hotel in the midst of a working vineyard.
The estate covers 16 acres of lush gardens and a working vineyard.
The hotel is at 776 Rapaura Road.
The estate is 10 minutes from Blenheim airport and 15 minutes from the town of Blenheim.
The convent building was relocated to its present site in Rapaura, Marlborough.
Harvest, the onsite restaurant, celebrates seasonal produce from the region and beyond and cooks with a Mibrasa charcoal oven.
A one-acre organic vegetable garden feeds directly into Harvest restaurant.
The gardens are a sanctuary for abundant birdlife.
The hotel can arrange private or group wine tours by vehicle, or cycling wine tours.
Marlborough is at the top of New Zealand's South Island.
The estate has easy access to State Highway 1 and State Highway 6, connecting to Christchurch and Nelson.

highlights.text: The hotel is a Victorian convent originally built in 1901 for the Sisters of Mercy and carefully preserved.
The gardens have over 400 different native and exotic trees and shrubs that run down to a spring-fed creek flowing through the estate.
Each room has a spacious ensuite and balcony access with garden and vineyard views.
The estate's own vineyards grow Merlot, Malbec, Riesling and Sauvignon Blanc, served at Harvest restaurant and in the guest rooms.
A garden and vineyard walking tour with the hotel's gardener runs at 9am each morning, with private tours on request at additional cost.

considerations.text: The hotel is out in the vineyards, 15 minutes from the town of Blenheim.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires advance planning for activities.
Regional activities are done self-drive, guided private or with a group, organised by the hotel with partners.
